summary: This 8-K reports the appointment of two independent directors, David Endicott and Linnea Burman, to the board of MiniMed Group, Inc., increasing board size from nine to 11. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or special-situation catalyst is disclosed. The appointments appear routine and compensatory in nature, without any associated M&A, activist, or restructuring event. As such, this filing does not represent a special situation.
